# S4.12 — SDK/embedding API full item + `serve`/`acp`/CLI surface family (C1)

- **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/074_S4.12__sdk-full-and-serve.md`
- **Branch:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.12` (stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-s4.11` @ `c39b806`)
- **Requirement:** R-2.11.4 (§7.4 SDK/embedding API — full C1 item); R-2.11.1 (§7.1 CLI — `serve`/`acp`/`leaderboard`/`profile`/`async`/`defer`/`participant`)
- **Closes:** R-2.11.4 (AC-R-2.11.4-{13,15} named in the run; the C1 item completes); R-2.11.1's `serve`/`acp` + noun slices (AC-R-2.11.1-{13,15})
- **ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0304-s4.12-embed-sdk-cli-surface-rulings.md`
- **Deferrals opened:** none.
- **Deferrals closed:** DF-S3.5-1 (`lab.assembly.compile` — implemented over both bindings with the canonical `CompiledBundle` codec). DF-S4.10-1 (HUMAN-H1) stays **gate pending** — an operator gate, not a code state.

## What landed

**`hh-embed-schema` (contract additions — additive, `hh-embed/1` major
unchanged, CC7/CC10):**

- `OpenSpec::New.notification_sink` — the `async`/`defer` carrier:
  `{kind:"file", path}` lowers `--defer`'s resume surface onto the
  open spec (§7.1 D-2; ADR-0304 D1).
- `OpenSessionParams.contract_json` — opaque contract-carried
  descriptor the opener binds; recorded verbatim, surfaced on
  `describe`, never interpreted (AC-R-2.11.4-15; ADR-0304 D2).
- `set_coordinate{session_id, coordinate, value, idempotency_key?}`
  (§7.4 §2.6; ADR-0177 D10) — `implemented: true` in the op registry.
- `UnknownCoordinate` (code 1602, additive) — the typed refusal for
  an unregistered/revoked coordinate value or an undeclared
  coordinate name; never a silent substitute (T-13).
- `lab.assembly.compile` marked `implemented: true` (closes
  DF-S3.5-1's codec obligation).
- Regenerated `schema/hh-embed-1.schema.json` +
  `crates/hh-embed-client-generated/src/generated.rs` (drift-checked).

**`hh-registry` — opaque record kinds (ADR-0304 D3):**

- `model_profile` and `profile_test_report` admitted as opaque
  record kinds behind the same canonical envelope +
  `trust_record_ref` admission every record obeys — no
  profile-specific bypass.
- Envelope decode arms for both kinds; `ProfileTestReport` decoding
  for compiler linking.

**`hh-embed` (service):**

- `open.rs` — notification-sink validation at `open_session`
  (kernel-side, before a session exists); the sink is a derived
  view, never an authority.
- `service.rs` — `contract_json` stored on the session and surfaced
  on `describe`; per-session `sink_seq` watermark; each successful
  session call sweeps durable `security.permission.*` /
  `lifecycle.run.suspended` rows since the watermark to the sink
  file (at-least-once; ADR-0304 D1).
- `work.rs::set_coordinate` — the `model` coordinate resolves
  through the registry (`UnknownCoordinate` on miss/revoked; any
  other name is `UnknownCoordinate`, never coerced); §3.2.2 relower
  re-runs stages 3–5 with `runtime_plan` identity re-checked
  (`PlanError` on divergence); `model.surface.relowered{old_bundle_id,
  new_bundle_id, old_profile_ref, new_profile_ref, dropped_items[],
  rewritten_items[], reason}` mints **before** the coordinate
  applies — durable-before-visible (ADR-0304 D5); the new bundle
  member is pool-addressed.
- `assembly_ops.rs::lab_assembly_compile` — boundary compile over
  `{source?|definition?, targets?, profile_refs?, fallback_profile?,
  compile_for_expired?}` returning the canonical `CompiledBundle`
  record; compile failures stay in-record
  (`{status:"error", compile_error, diagnostics}` — V-1).
- `bundle_ops.rs` — `lab.serve{target:<t>}` lowers the bundle's
  `target:<t>` member through `hh_compiler` (ADR-0304 D4); ACP
  artifact path for `target:acp`; `pinned_profile_refs` decodes the
  canonical `{profile_ref:<coord>, pinned:true}` HIR shape;
  `RegistryProfiles`/`resolve_profile_coordinate` — the one
  `ProfileView` over `RegistryStore` (ADR-0304 D3).

**`hh-acp` (surface crate):**

- `embed.rs` — `EmbedDriver`: an `hh-embed/1` client driving an ACP
  session — `open_session`/`register`/event-drain/`describe`; the
  binding-(a) `over_fn` seam for tests. Typed refusal plumbing —
  kind/code extraction, `CannotAnswer`/defer semantics.
- `transport.rs` — the stdio transport over the spawned kernel
  process (newline JSON-RPC through `Boundary`).

**`hh-cli` (surface — every verb one `hh-embed/1` op sequence through
`Boundary`):**

- `cli.rs` — `--async`/`--defer` (lowers to `notification_sink`;
  kernel-validated path syntax; `deferred` exit class leaves the run
  live — ADR-0304 D1); `--profile`, `--report`, `--probes`,
  `--participant-ref`, `--base`, `--drive` parsing.
- `lab.rs` — `serve` (verbatim `lab.serve` pass-through — never a
  second lowerer); `acp` (`lab.serve{target:acp}` artifact →
  `hh-acp::EmbedDriver` over stdio — the serve response is included
  in infrastructure failure diagnostics); `leaderboard *` (Group-L
  forwarding); `profile register|list|show|status|report` (registry
  ops — canonical body shape preserved, `trust_record_ref`
  honored); `participant register|describe|probe` (canonical `drive`
  object `{probes, adapter_version_id}` + `--base` report ref;
  `--drive` both flag-value and switch+positional forms;
  `hosting_plane_absent` typed refusal when the plane is missing —
  no fabricated data).

**`hh-mcp-lab`** — `launch.rs` adjusted for the `notification_sink`
member on `OpenSpec::New`.

## Assumption debt / stubs declared

- The ACP driver exercises the contract's op shapes over stdio; the
  upstream ACP ecosystem client binding remains HUMAN-H1's operator
  arm (DF-S4.10-1 — gate pending, proxy path green).
- `contract_json` is deliberately opaque — no kernel interpretation
  at C1 (ADR-0304 D2 revisit trigger covers the negotiation arm).
- Participant `conformance` posture: the probe arm runs the
  canonical drive object; further conformance-matrix arms await
  their owning requirement rows (nothing silently stubbed —
  unimplemented paths refuse typed).

## Notes

- Profile coordinate wire shape is `{profile_ref:<coord>,
  pinned:true}` — *not* `{profile:{...}}` (canonical HIR spelling;
  `pinned_profile_refs` + `set_coordinate` value decode share the
  one resolution path, ADR-0304 D5).
- All registry fixture registrations carry
  `--trust-record-ref` — canonical admission applies to
  `model_profile`/`profile_test_report` exactly as to every other
  record.
- `--drive` parses as a switch; the drive-params file may follow
  positionally — `cmd_participant_probe` honors both forms.
- PR stacks on S4.11's branch; merge is operator-controlled.
